content: Socket.io rooms are the standard primitive for isolating game instances (one room = one game code). For horizontal scaling beyond a single Node instance, use the Socket.io Redis adapter (pub/sub) so events broadcast to a room reach all server instances, plus sticky sessions at the load balancer so a client reconnects to the same instance. Single Node instance handles roughly 10k-30k concurrent connections before file descriptor/event loop/GC pressure degrades performance -- far beyond what a single blindtest game needs.
